brief.purpose: Somewhere to entertain, with a veg patch tucked out of the way.

concepts.name: Sweeping lawn
concepts.summary: A flowing lawn that bulges and narrows between deep planted bays, with a path that curves out of sight to a seat at the far end.

issues.message: Front path ends at nothing in particular.
5% of the garden is open grass, where a concept of this kind wants at least 20%.
32% of the ground has nothing designed onto it.
26% of the designed edges are straight in a plan whose open space is curved: lawn.
the water cannot be seen from the garden doors. A water feature is something to look at; out of sight it is a maintenance job.
6 different materials, where a naturalistic plan wants at most 4.
A planting bed is 0.70 m across, under the 1.2 m a border needs to be planted in layers.
There is not a tree in the garden, so nothing encloses it or gives it scale.

explanation.rationale: A garden built round one generous open lawn, organised around the terrace area. The terrace area is what this concept is not worth offering without.

decisions.text: Sweeping lawn. Deep planted bays either side of a lawn that opens out towards the far end.
Chosen from 11 arrangements of this garden, on circulation, grouping and how the space is proportioned.
Laid 2 paths beside the lawn rather than a path across the grass to each room.
Put the veg beds at the end of the view from the doors, so the eye has somewhere to land.
Kept the veg beds in a far corner, out of the view from the doors.
There was no bay for a second seating area that did not mean standing it on the lawn.
Put the seating patio directly outside the garden doors, 10.0 × 3.7 m.
Outdoor kitchen in the dining area, against the house wall, out of the way of the route onto the grass.
Veg beds in the working end of the garden, beside the other working areas.
Water feature at the far end, on the diagonal from the doors.
Kept the lawn as one continuous panel rather than cutting it into pieces.

concepts.name: Terrace and lawn
concepts.summary: A terrace across the doors, one clean lawn set off-centre so the planting runs deeper down one side, and the gathering places in the far corner.

requestedFeaturesIncluded.label: Water feature
requestedFeaturesIncluded.reason: No room for it in this composition without standing it on the lawn.

issues.message: Front path ends at nothing in particular.
27% of the garden is hard landscaping, where a concept of this kind wants at least 30%.

explanation.rationale: A garden built round eating and entertaining outside, organised around the dining area. The terrace area is what this concept is not worth offering without.

decisions.text: Terrace and lawn. A terrace, a gap and a rear border leave 2.5 m of lawn, which reads as a strip.
Chosen from 11 arrangements of this garden, on circulation, grouping and how the space is proportioned.
Kept the terrace modest so the dining area, which this concept is about, is the most generous room.
Stepped the planting in at one of the lawn’s near corners, so the lawn is entered between planting and opens out beyond.
Notched the lawn round one room rather than standing it on the grass.
Laid one path beside the lawn rather than a path across the grass to each room.
Put the veg beds at the end of the view from the doors, so the eye has somewhere to land.
Kept the veg beds in a far corner, out of the view from the doors.
There was no bay for water, a second seating area that did not mean standing it on the lawn.
Put the seating patio directly outside the garden doors, 7.0 × 3.7 m.
Outdoor kitchen in the dining area, against the house wall, out of the way of the route onto the grass.
Veg beds in the working end of the garden, beside the other working areas.
Kept the lawn as one continuous panel rather than cutting it into pieces.

concepts.name: Formal axis
concepts.summary: Everything mirrored about the view from the doors: a centred terrace, a paved line down the middle of the lawn, and a focal point at its end.

issues.message: Path to water feature cuts through a planting bed.
Path to water feature squeezes between two things with under 0.9 m to spare.
Front path ends at nothing in particular.
One thing on the plan answers to no purpose in the composition: Outdoor kitchen.
The open gravel has 0 inside corners and 2.5× the outline a compact shape of its area would have: it is the ground left over rather than a shape.
A planting bed is 0.70 m across, under the 1.2 m a border needs to be planted in layers.
This garden asks for more looking after than a low-upkeep brief allows: 41% of what a garden can demand, against 35%.

explanation.rationale: A garden built round deep planting and somewhere quiet to sit in it, organised around the terrace area. The terrace area is what this concept is not worth offering without.

decisions.text: Formal axis. An irregular plot has no symmetry for a formal plan to mirror about.
Chosen from 11 arrangements of this garden, on circulation, grouping and how the space is proportioned.
Put the seating patio directly outside the garden doors, 10.0 × 3.7 m.
Veg beds in the working end of the garden, beside the other working areas.
Water feature at the end of the axis, terminating the view from the doors.
Laid one open panel of gravel where a lawn would have been, since none was wanted.
